entities.summary: Bronislav Gimpel was a Polish-American violinist, and teacher. He was born in Lemberg, Austria-Hungary, part of Polish Galicia, to a family of Jewish origin. Gimpel's grandfather, Jaakov Ber Gimpel, created the Jewish Theatre in Lviv. Gimpel's father, Samuel, originally a clarinetist, also played violin and conducted the small theatre orchestra in which Bronislav played aged about eight. Gimpel's older brother, Jakob Gimpel, was a noted concert pianist who also recorded music for motion pictures.
